items.title: Keaton Mitchell (knee) did not practice on Thursday.
items.text: Mitchell and David Njoku (shoulder) remain sidelined through two practices. The tight end group is highly unlikely to produce reliably this week, even with Njoku sidelined. Mitchell’s likely absence gives Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal touch-count boosts. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Justin Herbert (concussion) did not practice on Thursday.
items.text: Herbert is firmly on the wrong side of questionable at this time, likely leaving DJ Uiagalelei as the team’s starter against the Patriots this week. The Chargers also signed Jake Browning from the practice squad to the active roster, which bodes poorly for Herbert’s availability. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) is active for Week 12 against the Cowboys.
items.text: The Eagles’ No. 1 cornerback is good to go this week. The Eagles declared EDGE Arnold Ebiketie, QB Cole Payton, CB Jonathan Jones, EDGE A.J. Epenesa, OT Ajani Cornelius and TE Grant Calcaterra inactive for Week 12 against the Cowboys. Payton is the emergency third quarterback. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Cowboys declared TE Jake Ferguson, RG Tyler Booker, WR Jonathan Mingo, S P.J. Locke, DT Jonathan Bullard and LB Jaishawn Barham inactive for Week 12 against the Eagles.
items.text: Ferguson will miss another game with knee and ankle injuries. Brevyn Spann-Ford is a touchdown-dependent fantasy TE2 in his stead. Ryan Flournoy will likely beneift from Ferguson’s absence. Losing Booker, the Cowboys’ starting right guard, for this one is unfortunate. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Juwan Johnson (hamstring) is day-to-day.
items.text: Johnson was not seen practicing today, so we expect to see him listed as a non-participant on the Saints’ official injury report. He looks like a long shot for Week 12 against the Bengals. Noah Fant is a TE2 with Johnson sidelined. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Tyler Badie (thumb) is questionable for Week 12 against the Steelers.
items.text: Badie could return from injured reserve this week. The Broncos need an RB2 with JK Dobbins suspended for one game, but Badie would not be worth rostering in 12-team leagues, even if he fills that role. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) is not on the final injury report and will play in Week 12 against the Broncos.
items.text: Herbig is good to go. Steelers LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) and OG Gennings Dunker (knee) are ruled out. Steelers LB Cole Holcomb (heel) is questionable. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Steelers placed Ben Skowronek on injured reserve with a calf injury.
items.text: Skowronek leaves the active roster while Michael Pittman (foot) makes his return. The Steelers also signed Max Hurleman from the practice squad to the active roster. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Steelers activated Michael Pittman (foot) from injured reserve.
items.text: Pittman is on track to play in Week 12 against the Broncos, catching passes thrown by Mason Rudolph. He is only a WR4/FLEX, given the circumstances. The Steelers’ offense might need a week or two to adjust to their new quarterback. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Colston Loveland was ruled out in Week 12 against the Lions after suffering a knee injury.
items.text: This is concerning. A Lions defender tumbled into Loveland’s lower leg left while the Bears’ tight end was blocking on a run play. After a brief trip to the trainer’s table, he was taken to the locker room for further evaluation. It took only 15 minutes for the team to rule him out. Before exiting, Loveland caught 1-of-1 targets for five yards and lost one fumble. On his lone catch, a Lions defender tied up his legs while a second defender ran in and punched the ball out of his possession.
